To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MU MIMO with flexible bandwidth allocations for paired users and clustered DFTS OFDM with multiple clusters are effective in enhancing the system performance of LTE Advanced uplink.
the combination of MU MIMO with multiple cluster transmission can significantly improve the system performance in LTE Advanced uplink.
the system performance of LTE Advanced uplink can be improved by combining the multi cluster transmission and the MU MIMO with the different bandwidth allocations.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: • The evaluation of the system performance of multi cluster transmission with and without multi user MIMO (MU-MIMO), and the impact of different frequency and spatial resource allocations for MU-MIMO.

a novel system level evaluation of MU MIMO with multiple cluster transmission in LTE Advanced, and the results of our research can be used as a basis for further studies on the performance of MU MIMOs with multi cluster transmissions

the following aspects: (i) the evaluation of the system performance of the combination of MU MIMO with OCC and multi cluster transmission, (ii) the investigation of the impact of different bandwidth allocations for the paired UE on the performance of MU MIM, and (iii) the evaluation of different frequency and spatial resource allocations for the paired MU UE.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MU MIMO and clustered OFDM transmission are two key technologies for enhancing the spectrum and power efficiency in the uplink of LTE Advanced.
the proposed frequency and spatial resource allocations for MU MIMO and multi cluster transmission are effective in enhancing the spectral efficiency and system performance in LTE-Advanced uplink.
the combination of MU MIMO with OCC and multi cluster transmission is an effective means to enhance the spectrum efficiency and system capacity in the LTE Advanced system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the system performance of multi cluster transmission is improved by using the multi cluster transmissions in the MU MIMO UEs.
the system level simulation results show that the performance of MU Mimo with multi cluster transmission is improved in the LTE-Advanced Uplink.

the combination of MU MIMO with OCC and multi cluster transmission provides significant performance enhancement in LTE Advanced uplink, and that this performance enhancement can be achieved even with different bandwidth allocations for the paired MU-MIMO UEs.
The main takeaway from our work is that

MU MIMO and multi cluster transmissions can be combined to improve spectrum efficiency and the bandwidth allocation of MU MIMO UEs should be optimized considering the bandwidth allocation restrictions for the paired MU UEs.

the performance gain is more significant for the multi cluster transmission with the bandwidth allocation restriction than the one without bandwidth allocation restriction, and the performance gain is also dependent on the number of clusters.
the performance of MU MIM with different bandwidth allocations can be improved significantly by using multi cluster transmission.
